protocol.design: symmetric 2x2 factorial (translation x ranking) built offline from frozen candidate pools
protocol.lexical_construction: dedupe_candidates() then rank_candidates(expected_title=query) with empty candidates dropped, applied identically to the frozen M2 and M3 pools
protocol.reranker: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, query = the English variant query (same as the pipeline)

interaction_recall20_frozen.note: Difference-in-differences of Recall@20: (M3r - M2r) - (M3l - M2l). Positive means the cross-encoder adds more on the translated pool.

interaction_recall20_expanded.note: Difference-in-differences of Recall@20: (M3r - M2r) - (M3l - M2l). Positive means the cross-encoder adds more on the translated pool.

caveats: The recorded M3 permutation is not reproducible by re-applying the documented ranker to the stored M3 list (Recall@20 0.276 recorded vs about 0.306 re-ranked); both are reported. The expanded reference set is heuristic and title-based, like the frozen one.
